Zenithy La Ville

Villa in Ko Kaeo
HomeSaleZenithy La Ville

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A gated boutique community of 22 two-storey pool villas in Koh Kaew, aimed at families and long-term investors who want schools and marinas close by. Each villa has three en-suite bedrooms, a mezzanine and a private pool with Jacuzzi, and the site is not within walking distance of a beach.

Zenithy La Ville: key facts

  • Zenithy La Ville is a pool villa in Ko Kaeo, Phuket, developed by Zenithy Development.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 342–357.4 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Jan 2029.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿19,900,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (13.3 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: British International School Phuket (1.8 km); Finnway International School (3.0 km); Boat Lagoon Marina (4.0 km); Royal Phuket Marina (4.4 km).

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Swimming pool with poolside
  • Private pool with Jacuzzi per villa
  • Automatic gate with video intercom
  • Landscaping and pool maintenance services
